💼 Sales

How to Handle Online Sales orders with Pick-up at a dealer?

As soon as you realize that a pick up of an online sales order is at the dealer you should follow this procedure.

1
Open another TAB now in your browser and access odoo.
2
Go in the Sales App
3
Click “NEW” Please be careful tClick “NEW”
4
Please be careful to input the info in the correct order because it will influence the fiscal position, the taxes declaration and the product prices.
5
First Input the customer name. Since the customer is probably not existing after writing the name you will have to click “Create & Edit”
6
After filling the information in Odoo you can click “SAVE & CLOSE”
NOTE: Imagine that Sarah Delgado was a company, in that case you need to click on “company” and add a “VAT number”.
7
Sales Team: make sure is set on “Online”
8
Customer reference: Make sure to write the Shopify Sales order number. In this case is #XXXX.
9
Fiscal position: remove for the time being any fiscal position. Let it blank like this the pricelist – that should be set on “public pricelist” will set the correct prices in the order.
10
Tags: Select “Shopify”
11
Tags: Select as well the tag of the type of bike : “A-MAX”, “E-MAX”, “Power+”, “MOD Low”, “MOD Uni”. Note: you can add as many tag as you want in the tag section.
12
Warehouse – be carefull wrong warehouse will trigger problems in Supply Team: Select Ahooga Anderlecht because it is a shipment to a retailer. Just as a reminder this is the Matrix to follow:
Shipping typeWarehouse in Odoo
🏠 Pick up in store at Brussels Ahooga Store (Louise)Ahooga Louise
🏠 Pick up in store at dealer nameAhooga Anderlecht
🚚 Standard deliveryAhooga Anderlecht
13
You can now add the products in “order lines”:
14
Click on Add product and add all the product there are in the shopify orders
15
Click “Add a note” and write “Paid via Shopify on DD/MM” where DD means day and MM means month. This will allow Supply team to know that the order is already been paid. You can see if it is paid or not in Shopify. If Shopify shows still in “Payment pending” do not confirm the sales order.
NOTE: IMPORTANT!!!
16
In Shopify commercial discounts are integrated immediately in the products, in Odoo they are NOT. You need to add a line call “commercial discount” and add in the unit price a negative amount to have a reduction of the price.
17
Add Shipping if in shopify there was a shipping included. Please double check that the price is the same between Odoo and Shopify. If NOT, modify the shipping price MANUALLY.
18
Go Back to “Other info” and put in Fiscal position the correct Fiscal Position either:
19
EU prive / Regime National if it is a Sales Order in Belgium
20
OSS B2C Germany – if it is a sales order for a german client
21
OSS B2C France – if it is a sales order for a client in France
22
OSS B2C Netherland - if it is a sales order for a client in Netherlands...
23
Etc etc
24
Then Click “Update Taxes” - this will set the correct VAT in the sales order.
25
Now go back to “Order Lines”
26
At the end of the order please compare the total price of the sales order in odoo and the total price of the order in Shopify. Odoo order must match Shopify order because client paid what Shopify told the client to pay. If total is not matching please re-check the prices in Odoo and modify them manually. Re-check the total again if it is matching with Shopify. NEVER CONFIRM AN ODOO ORDER IF NOT MATCHING WITH SHOPIFY.
27
Change now “Delivery Address” to the dealer location that the customer chose as pick up point. AS below:
28
Now you can confirm the order!!
29
Go now in Accounting App (or request Finance Resp to go in Accounting App)
30
Click “NEW”
31
Add the client name
32
Add in the line “Discount Voucher” and put in the Unit price write the 26% of the total purchased priced in Shopify. Be careful that the 26% of the purchase price needs to consider VAT if the dealer is from Belgium, if NOT in Belgium only 26% of the non-taxed amount.
33
Total Purchased price 1699 Euro VAT incl =
34
In Belgium 1699 * 0,26 = 441,74
35
Outside Belgium (1699 / (1+VAT Value of the country)*0,26
36
Example Germany ( 1699 / 1,19 ) * 0, 26 = 371, 21 Euro
37
Example France (1699 / 1,20 ) * 0,26 = 368,11 Euro
38
You can also calculate it by going to Shopify checking the total purchased price and remove the total amount of taxes as in the example below:
39
You click then “PRINT” to download the credit note document PDF.
40
You need now to communicate to the dealer that a sales order for a B2C client will be picked up in its store, you need to send in attachment:
41
A screen shot of the shopify order with the final B2C client information
42
The PDF of the credit note / voucher equivalent for 26% margin.

In appendix you have the templates e-mail for 4 languages: ENG, FR, NL, DE.

43
Put a log note in the sales order to inform the retailer when the bikes are shipped, and tell the retailer to contact the client.

📧 Appendix — Email templates (4 languages)

Use these templates to communicate to the dealer when a B2C pickup order arrives at their store.

🇬🇧 English

Dear {{Partner Name}},

We are pleased to inform you that an online sale has been completed with {{Store Name}} selected as the pickup location.

For each online order with pickup at your store, you are entitled to receive a voucher (credit note) equivalent to 26% of the purchase value. You will find the detailed compensation breakdown as well as the order details attached. This voucher can be used on your next purchase with us, allowing you to deduct its value from the total amount due.

By accepting this voucher, the customer who placed the order through our online store becomes your customer for all practical purposes. The sale should therefore be treated as if it had been made directly through your physical store:

44
Delivery of the bike is at your charge.
45
From that point onward, the customer is handled by your shop for after-sales service, including repairs, warranty, and ongoing support.

Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or need further clarification.

Best regards,

The Ahooga Team

🇫🇷 French

Cher / Chère {{Nom du partenaire}},

Nous avons le plaisir de vous informer qu’une vente en ligne a été réalisée avec {{Nom du magasin}} sélectionné comme point de retrait.

Pour chaque commande en ligne avec retrait dans votre magasin, vous bénéficiez d’un bon d’achat (note de crédit) équivalent à 26% de la valeur de la commande, hors TVA. Vous trouverez en pièce jointe le détail de votre compensation ainsi que les informations relatives à la commande. Ce bon pourra être utilisé lors de votre prochaine commande chez nous, en déduction du montant total.

En acceptant ce bon, le client ayant commandé via notre boutique en ligne devient votre client à tous égards. La vente doit donc être considérée comme réalisée directement dans votre magasin :

46
La livraison du vélo est à votre charge.
47
Le client est ensuite pris en charge par votre magasin pour le service après-vente, y compris les réparations, la garantie et l’assistance.

N’hésitez pas à nous contacter si vous avez des questions ou besoin de précisions supplémentaires.

Bien cordialement,

L’équipe Ahooga

🇧🇪 Dutch

Beste {{Naam partner}},

Wij informeren u graag dat er een online verkoop is afgerond waarbij {{Winkelnaam}} werd gekozen als afhaalpunt.

Voor elke online bestelling met afhaling in uw winkel ontvangt u een voucher (creditnota) ter waarde van 26% van het aankoopbedrag, exclusief btw. In de bijlage vindt u zowel de details van de compensatie als de bestelgegevens. Deze voucher kan worden gebruikt bij uw volgende bestelling bij ons, waarbij het bedrag in mindering wordt gebracht van het totaal.

Door de aanvaarding van deze voucher wordt de klant die via onze online shop heeft besteld volledig uw klant. De verkoop dient dan ook te worden beschouwd alsof deze rechtstreeks in uw fysieke winkel heeft plaatsgevonden:

48
De levering van de fiets gebeurt op uw kosten.
49
Vanaf dat moment staat uw winkel in voor de verdere opvolging van de klant, inclusief herstellingen, garantie en ondersteuning.

Aarzel niet om ons te contacteren indien u vragen heeft of verdere toelichting wenst.

Met vriendelijke groeten,

Het Ahooga-team

🇩🇪 German

Lieber / Liebe {{Name des Partners}},

Wir freuen uns, Ihnen mitteilen zu können, dass ein Online-Verkauf abgeschlossen wurde, bei dem {{Name des Geschäfts}} als Abholort ausgewählt wurde.

Für jede Online-Bestellung mit Abholung in Ihrem Geschäft erhalten Sie einen Gutschein (Gutschrift) in Höhe von 26% des Kaufwerts, exklusive Mehrwertsteuer. Die detaillierten Informationen zu Ihrer Vergütung sowie die Bestelldetails finden Sie im Anhang. Dieser Gutschein kann bei Ihrer nächsten Bestellung bei uns eingelöst werden, indem der entsprechende Betrag vom Gesamtbetrag abgezogen wird.

Mit der Annahme dieses Gutscheins wird der Kunde, der über unseren Online-Shop bestellt hat, in jeder Hinsicht zu Ihrem Kunden. Der Verkauf ist daher so zu behandeln, als wäre er direkt in Ihrem Ladengeschäft erfolgt:

50
Die Auslieferung des Fahrrads erfolgt auf Ihre Kosten.
51
Die weitere Betreuung des Kunden liegt bei Ihrem Geschäft, einschließlich Reparaturen, Garantieabwicklung und Support.

Bitte zögern Sie nicht, uns bei Fragen oder für weitere Informationen zu kontaktieren.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Das Ahooga-Team
